column2: the token copies of Krosan Adaptation are considered to have been “created”
column3: Outdated: Mystery Booster playtest-card ruling (release notes 2019-11-11, ruling dated 2019-11-12), which applied the then-general "create" definition (701.6, Kaladesh Update Bulletin 2016-09-30: create = put a token onto the battlefield); the Comprehensive Rules changes of 2020-09-22 (Matt Tabak, Zendikar Rising) added 111.11 (now 111.13) and 608.3b (now 608.3f), under which a resolving copy of a permanent spell becomes a token that is not "created" ("Sorry, Doubling Season fans"); later rulings agree (Frontline Heroism 2024-11-08, cited); the card itself is a playtest card legal nowhere (otherwise deferred, docs/DEFERRED.md), kept here so the resolved conflict stays on record; current behavior tested in tests/rulings/r_p076_spells_and_mana.rs
